sections.name: POST
sections.title: Audio transcription handler
sections.what: Receives an uploaded audio file, sends it to Groq's Whisper model and returns the spoken text. It also returns clear messages for a missing key, bad upload, missing file or rate limit.
sections.why: Likely reason: keeps the Groq key on the server and gives the app one place to convert speech to text.
sections.watch_out: Anyone who can reach this address can use the Groq quota, because no login check is made.

summary: A server endpoint that receives an uploaded audio file and returns its text using Groq's Whisper speech-to-text model.
purpose: Lets the app turn spoken words into text without exposing the Groq secret key to the browser.
why: Likely reason: the key is read from server settings so it stays private.
how: 1) Checks the server has a Groq key. 2) Reads the uploaded form data and finds the file. 3) Sends the file to Groq for transcription. 4) Returns the text. Any failure returns an error message, with a rate limit flagged separately.
inputs: A form upload with a file field named file, and the GROQ_API_KEY setting on the server.
outputs: A JSON reply with the text, or an error message with a status code.
risks: There is no check on who is calling, so anyone who can reach this address can use the Groq quota. There is also no limit on file size or type.
debug: If a request fails, check the server log lines that start with API/Transcribe. A 400 with a key message means GROQ_API_KEY is missing. A 429 means the Groq rate limit was hit.
